#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll pow_mod(ll base, ll power, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (power != 0) {
        if (power % 2 != 0) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        power /= 2;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    while (cin >> p >> k) {
        if (k == 0) {
            cout << pow_mod(p, p - 1, MOD) << endl;
            continue;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            cout << pow_mod(p, p, MOD) << endl;
            continue;
        }

        vector<bool> visited(p);
        ll good = 0;

        for (ll i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (visited[i]) continue;

            ll cur = i;
            ll len = 0;

            while (!visited[cur]) {
                ++len;
                visited[cur] = true;
                cur = (cur * k) % p;
            }

            if (pow_mod(k, len, p) == 1) ++good;
        }

        cout << pow_mod(p, good, MOD) << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

class Solver {
    ll p, k;

    static ll mod_pow(ll base, ll power, ll mod) {
        ll result = 1;
        while (power != 0) {
            if (power % 2 != 0) result = (result * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            power /= 2;
        }
        return result;
    }

public:
    Solver(ll p_, ll k_) : p(p_), k(k_) {}

    ll solve() const {
        if (k == 0) return mod_pow(p, p - 1, MOD);
        if (k == 1) return mod_pow(p, p, MOD);

        vector<bool> seen(p);
        ll cycles = 0;

        for (ll start = 1; start < p; ++start) {
            if (seen[start]) continue;

            ll current = start;
            ll length = 0;

            while (!seen[current]) {
                ++length;
                seen[current] = true;
                current = (current * k) % p;
            }

            if (mod_pow(k, length, p) == 1) ++cycles;
        }

        return mod_pow(p, cycles, MOD);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    while (cin >> p >> k) {
        Solver solver(p, k);
        cout << solver.solve() << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
